title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): ICC Premium Returned on Cancellation
content:
Refund schedule entry for the Increased Cost of Compliance premium on a cancelled policy under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own).

**Rule.** The ICC premium a cancellation refund returns is settled as follows: when the policy's tier carries no ICC coverage, nothing is returned; when the cancellation took effect before the current term start, the current term's ICC premium charges are returned in full and those of the term before it for the days from the cancellation effective date to the current term start over the days of the current term, or in full when the cancellation took effect on or before that term's start; otherwise the current term's ICC premium charges are returned for the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end over the days of the current term.

**Tiers without ICC.** ICC coverage does not attach on the NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit tier; it attaches on the other five tiers.

## Schedule

| Tier carries ICC | Cancellation effective date | ICC premium returned |
|---|---|---|
| no | any | nothing |
| yes | on or before the start of the preceding term | current term's and preceding term's ICC premium in full |
| yes | within the preceding term | current term's in full; preceding term's for the days to the current term start over the days of the current term |
| yes | on or after the current term start | current term's for the days to the term end over the days of the current term |

## Cases (hypothetical; 365-day current term)

- Current term ICC premium 73.00, cancellation effective with 146 days left: 29.20.
- Effective 73 days before the current term start; current ICC 73.00, preceding ICC 70.00: 73.00 plus 14.00, which is 87.00.
- A Non-Residential Condominium Unit policy: nothing.
